# windows_local_groups (Data Source)

Reads the local group inventory of the remote Windows host without managing it. This is a **sibling collection** of `windows_local_group` — every `groups` element carries the same attributes as the singular data source, plus `is_builtin` and the `members` list.

Optional filters narrow the result: `names` / `sids` (exact match, host-side), `name_regex` (RE2 match on the group name, case-sensitive unless prefixed with `(?i)`), `include_builtin` (drop built-in groups such as Administrators and Users) and `include_members` (populate the per-group `members` list with `name`, `sid`, `object_class` and `principal_source`). Omitted filters match everything.

`groups` carries one object per matching group, sorted by name (case-insensitive); `names` and `sids` carry the same groups in the same order. An empty match is a valid empty list, never an error.

The Terraform data source ID is a query-ID: the hex SHA-256 of the normalised filter set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Every non-built-in local group on the target host, with membership.
data "windows_local_groups" "custom" {
  include_builtin = false
  include_members = true
}

output "custom_group_names" {
  value       = data.windows_local_groups.custom.names
  description = "Names of every non-built-in local group on the host."
}

check "no_unexpected_admins" {
  assert {
    condition     = alltrue([for g in data.windows_local_groups.custom.groups : g.is_builtin || startswith(g.name, "svc-")])
    error_message = "Unexpected non-built-in local group found; review the group inventory."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_builtin` (Boolean) Whether to include built-in groups (SID under the S-1-5-32 BUILTIN authority, e.g. Administrators, Users). Omit (null) means true.
- `include_members` (Boolean) Whether to populate the per-group members list. Omit (null) means false; members is null on every group element unless requested.
- `name_regex` (String) Restrict the result to groups whose name matches this RE2 regular expression (case-sensitive; prefix the pattern with (?i) for a case-insensitive match).
- `names` (Set of String) Restrict the result to these group names (exact match, host-side). Omit (null) to match every name; the state carries the matched names in group order.
- `sids` (Set of String) Restrict the result to these group SIDs (exact match, host-side). Omit (null) to match every SID; the state carries the matched SIDs in group order.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Matching local groups, sorted by name (case-insensitive). Empty when no group matches the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Data source ID (query-ID); hex SHA-256 of the normalised filter set (sorted names, sorted SIDs, raw regex, include_builtin, include_members).

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Free-text description of the group as returned by Windows.
- `is_builtin` (Boolean) True when the group is a built-in group (SID under the S-1-5-32 BUILTIN authority, e.g. Administrators).
- `members` (Attributes List) Members of the group, sorted by member SID. Null when membership was not requested (include_members false); empty when the group has no members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups--members))
- `name` (String) Name of the local group.
- `sid` (String) Security Identifier of the group.

<a id="nestedatt--groups--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups.members`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Display name of the member as reported by Windows; empty string for orphaned SIDs.
- `object_class` (String) Windows account class (e.g. User, Group); Unknown when the fallback tiers cannot observe it.
- `principal_source` (String) Account origin: Local, ActiveDirectory, AzureAD, MicrosoftAccount, or Unknown (orphaned SID).
- `sid` (String) Security Identifier of the member account.
